name: Following Man
overview: Scripture warns against placing trust in man rather than in the Lord, emphasizing that human wisdom and ways often lead to death despite seeming right (Psalms 118:8; Proverbs 14:12). Jesus rebukes the practice of following human traditions that contradict God's commandments, describing such teachings as vain and those who propagate them as blind leaders destined to fall (Matthew 15:9, 13-14). The Apostle Paul further cautions believers to reject any gospel that deviates from the truth they have received, underscoring the necessity of discerning and adhering solely to God's revealed Word rather than human doctrines (Galatians 1:9).
